title: Cellular gateways software versions MG 26.1.2 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new Beta MG Wireless WAN firmware is now available

Executive summary: This is the second MG 26.1 beta release. It contains a few bug fixes related to the device local status page.
Please see the full details below.
Bug fixes: Fixed an issue that could result in MG appliances incorrectly dropping fragmented traffic. (MG-6135)
Resolved an issue that resulted in the device local status page not displaying the SIM PIN configuration when only one SIM was present. (MG-6191)
Corrected an issue that resulted in MG appliances not displaying their cellular IP address on the device local status page when operating in Wired WAN Mode. (MG-6192)

html:
Cellular gateways software versions MG 26.1.2 changelog

Executive summary

  • This is the second MG 26.1 beta release. It contains a few bug fixes related to the device local status page.

  • Please see the full details below.

Bug fixes

  • Fixed an issue that could result in MG appliances incorrectly dropping fragmented traffic. (MG-6135)

  • Resolved an issue that resulted in the device local status page not displaying the SIM PIN configuration when only one SIM was present. (MG-6191)

  • Corrected an issue that resulted in MG appliances not displaying their cellular IP address on the device local status page when operating in Wired WAN Mode. (MG-6192)
